title: Rounding across two Jackson numeric conversion paths
summary: Jackson and Commons Lang convert wide integer and tiny binary64 inputs to binary32 at independently checked rounding boundaries.

subject.system: Rounding across two Jackson numeric conversion paths

change.description: Jackson and Commons Lang convert wide integer and tiny binary64 inputs to binary32 at independently checked rounding boundaries.

notes: The opening comparison uses the released JARs and Temurin 21.0.13. The standalone, ordinary native, integrated JBMC and physical JVM evidence is measured per statement.

The Jackson conversions disagree at 16,777,216 of the 2⁵⁴ admitted long values. The direct binary64 underflow interval contains 2⁵² + 1 values, including the halfway input that rounds to positive zero.
